failures.feature: Two questions of the day (their R&W + Math): T14's third slot, Word in context
failures.why_not_way_better: The answer to the R&W slot is shown on the same page. T14 (today.md:906) makes the slot 'the day's SAT word as an In-context item', so the key is the SAT word of the day. The Words tile on Today prints that word with its meaning ('Word · corroborate: to confirm with evidence', rebuild-v2.md:9702; acceptance rebuild-v2.md:10013 requires it), and /words/ does too (9426). Anyone who looks one card over gets it right, so the % right, the spread and the streak mean nothing. There are other problems. (1) The slot is conditional: until S9 ships words.daily_item there is no R&W at all (today.md:915), which is below theirs. (2) It only ever tests one R&W skill, Words in Context, while theirs is a full passage question from any of the 4 R&W domains. (3) Stale rules are left in place: completion is still 'both slots answered' (rebuild-v2.md:2555), Why still says 'The same two for everyone' (2546), and 'Now its twin' is undefined for the word slot, which has only 1–3 authored cloze items per word. (4) Slot keys 'mcq'/'spr'/'word' carry no subject, even though decision 3 requires subject-aware data where it costs little. An R&W multiple-choice slot would collide with 'mcq'. (5) After a right answer, v2 still keeps the rationale behind Why (2642), and decision 4 forbids hiding it.
failures.fix: Choose the word-slot item from a word that is not today's SAT word of the day. Better still, show that word on the Words tile and on /words/ only after the slot is answered. Use `sha256('qotd-word:'+day)` over SAT words that have at least 2 authored in-context items. Then 'Now its twin' is the word's second item, and the slot shows 'no twin' when none exists. Rename the slots `{subject:'math', fmt:'mcq'|'spr'}` and `{subject:'rw', fmt:'word'}`, with sessions `qotd:{subject}:{fmt}:{day}`. Keep the old keys as aliases. Change completion to 'every slot shown answered', and Why to 'The same N for everyone, one try each'. Show the rationale open after every answer. Add an acceptance check: after the word slot loads, and before it is answered, no element on / contains the slot's key word.

failures.feature: Today's Plan card (their checkbox rows, Mark done, All Done): T2 Due today
failures.why_not_way_better: T2 lists 'custom' plan tasks as Due rows (today.md:259). The Plan section says the Today card has 'checkboxes for your own tasks' (rebuild-v2.md:7156, 7863), and R13 counts 'minutes of the student's own plan tasks marked done'. But Today's completion rules (v2 2552–2556 and T2 286–292) have no rule for a custom task, and v2 says 'there is no checkbox'. A student's own R&W-study task, which is how the plan covers the half of the SAT we don't teach, can never turn done on Today. So 'N of M done' and 'about 34 min left' stay wrong all day. Theirs has a checkbox on every row. T2 also leaves open whether the plan's qotd/challenge task kinds (Task.kind in rebuild-v2.md:7966) are counted in the PLAN figures or shown under ALSO DUE, so the header counts can disagree with /plan/.
failures.fix: In T2's row spec, make the status box of a custom (own) task a real checkbox with the labels 'Mark as done' / 'Mark as not done'. It sends S7's PATCH /api/plan/{id}/tasks/{task} {status:'marked'} with Undo. Add 'Own task: ticked' to the completion rules. State that plan tasks of kind qotd and challenge render only as the ALSO DUE rows, and that PLAN's N of M excludes them, matching plan.today_summary. Add an acceptance check: a custom task ticked on Today reads done on /plan/, and study.today rises by its minutes.

failures.feature: Single next action (their missing one): T1 time box
failures.why_not_way_better: T1 moves v2's count chips, the Timed/Untimed clock and More options behind a `.quiet Count instead` link (today.md:172). These are useful controls collapsed to make the card look calmer, which decision 4 forbids by name ('control… never collapsed away or hidden'). In the default time-box mode there is no clock toggle at all, so a student can't ask for a timed 15-minute set. The defaults also contradict each other: when the goal is met, 'daily goal minus today's minutes' gives a default box of 5, but the goal-met pill reads 'Keep going · 15 min' (today.md:183).
failures.fix: Show both sizing modes at once as one labelled row: `Size: [Time 5·15·30·45·60 min] or [Count 5·10·22·{coach}·Endless]`. The two are mutually exclusive, and choosing one clears the other. Keep the `.clock` Timed/Untimed toggle and `More options` always visible beside the pill. Define the goal-met default box as 15, so the seg and the pill agree.

failures.feature: Accuracy by domain / score progress: T6 Points on the table
failures.why_not_way_better: T6 shows 6 skill rows and puts the other 13 behind `.quiet Show all 19` (today.md:483). That is collapsing to save space, which decision 4 forbids, and it hides the very skills a student would compare. The pace row in #gain and the #pace card also price the same fact with two different formulas on one page. T6 computes `S − _interpolate(F×(22−blanks)/22)` (today.md:515), which applies one module's blanks to the whole 44-question F, so it roughly doubles the blanks. T8 computes `blanks × per_question` (today.md:610, 639). At F≈0.6 with 2 blanks, #gain says 'Pace ≈ +30' while #pace says '≈ −25 points from time alone'. That breaks the 'one source per fact' rule this file adds (today.md:1214).
failures.fix: Render all 19 rows, sorted, with the seg sticky in the card header. If grouping is wanted, split them into 'Top 6' and 'The other 13', both visible. Define the time cost once, as `estimate.time_cost(learner)` = `S − _interpolate(F − 2·blanks_per_module·w_medium/W_section)`, returned in `insights.pace.pts_lost`. Have T6's pace row print that same value. Add an assert that `gains.extras[pace].gain == pace.pts_lost`.

failures.feature: Where your points went (T7) and blind spots (T9): the answer to their Correct/Incorrect/Unanswered
failures.why_not_way_better: The 'entry' rule is not buildable as written. 'Matches the key at 2 significant figures but not by grid_equal' (today.md:546) fails its own check: 0.66 against 2/3 (0.6667) rounds to 0.66 against 0.67, so acceptance 1 (today.md:587) fails. It also marks real conceptual misses as form errors: key 460 with 455 typed, or key 150 with 154, both match at 2 s.f., and the student is told 'right value, rejected form'. T7 and T9 also label the same miss in opposite ways. An easy miss answered in under half the median time is a 'slip' in T7, with 'You know these' (today.md:550, 572). Under T9's rule (faster than 0.6× median, today.md:670) the same attempt is a 'Sure · blind spot', with 'You were sure and wrong'. Because T7 checks slip before trap, a fast pick of a named-misconception distractor is counted as a slip in the causes bar, while the Mistakes card lists it as a blind-spot trap.
failures.fix: Define entry by exact equivalence only. A miss is an entry error when (a) `scoring.accepted_forms` shows the value equals the key but the form is rejected (a mixed number, too many characters), or (b) the typed decimal is a truncated or rounded prefix of the key's decimal expansion that is shorter than the grid needs (.66 or .67 for 2/3). Nothing else counts, and there is no s.f. tolerance. Add check cases: 455 against 460 is not entry, and .66 against 2/3 is entry. Order T7's causes clock → entry → trap → slip → gap, so a named misconception is never a slip. Change T9's 'Sure' to `qstate.conf=='sure'` only, or to fast answers on medium or hard questions, and never apply it to an attempt T7 classed as a slip.

failures.feature: Exam countdown (their DD:HH:MM:SS) and daily goal (their Daily 2 Hours): T12 capacity vs need, T17 suggested goal
failures.why_not_way_better: The main figure claims to say 'whether the time left is enough' (today.md:68). But `today.workload`'s need is only open traps, check-ins, tests and warm-ups (today.md:806). It ignores the target gap and the skills not yet learned. A new or low-data student with no mistakes, 200 points below target, reads 'Needed: 0 open mistakes · 2 sections · warm-ups · fits, with 4h to spare'. T17 turns the same arithmetic into 'Suggested: N min' (today.md:1027), which for that student can come out under 15 minutes a day. So the page tells the students who most need time that they have plenty. Theirs says nothing, which is less harmful than being wrong.
failures.fix: Add a 'to target' term to the need, using U4, which Today already computes. Take skills in gain order and add each one's `minutes` (the time for `to_strong` right answers at the learner's median) until the summed gain reaches `target − band midpoint`. Print it as its own item: 'reach 700: Circles, Probability, Nonlinear functions (~6h)'. When `gains` is null (under 30 answers) or there is no target, don't print 'fits' or 'Suggested'. Print 'Answer 30 questions to size the work · 12 of 30' instead. Floor the suggestion at 15 min, the smallest chip.

failures.feature: Study plan CTA (their Build My Plan, 1 per cycle): T18 Build with these
failures.why_not_way_better: The one-tap plan has no starting score for the most common no-plan student, one who has practised but never taken a test, or a brand-new student. 'The start is the latest band's midpoint' and 'target… else the band's high end + 50' (today.md:1078) have no fallback. The Plan wizard needs a start (Step 1 has four source variants, rebuild-v2.md:7324–7331), but Build with these offers only date, daily time and days. Acceptance 1 uses 'a learner with 40 answers', who may have no sitting at all, so the check itself is undefined.
failures.fix: Add a fourth inline control, `Start from`, prefilled with the same four variants as Plan step 1. With 2 or more sittings: 'mean3 · Use 650'. With 1: its midpoint. Practice only: a 200–800 slider with '[Take a module · 35 min]'. New: '[Diagnostic · 20 q]', or 'Your best guess' as a slider. If there is no band, default the target to start + 100 and show it as a chip that opens the target dialog. Disable 'Use this plan' until a start exists, and add acceptance checks for the no-sitting case.

failures.feature: Week pager and day tiles (their 'Week N · X of Y tasks · Z%', theme sentence, progress bar)
failures.why_not_way_better: Today's plan week strip (rebuild-v2.md:2787–2799, plus T18's per-day bars) has 'Week 3 of 7' but no week total ('X of Y · Z%') and no week theme line. Theirs has both, and our own plan.py already returns them (`weeks[{theme, tasks_planned, tasks_done}]`, rebuild-v2.md:7966; Plan fix 8 at 7150). So the Today version drops two things of theirs that the data already supports, and the scorecard's 'the same, plus…' (today.md:61) is not true.
failures.fix: Under the pager, add `Week 3 of 7 · 8 of 12 tasks · 67%` with a 4px bar. Under it, add the server's theme line (`Build · Circles, Percentages, Nonlinear functions · Module test Fri`), both read from `/api/today.plan.weeks[n]`. Add an acceptance check that they match /plan/'s week header.

failures.feature: The last weeks (their 'Exam day has arrived'): T13 Final stretch and the v2 checklist
failures.why_not_way_better: Two things are hidden in the part of the page that matters most. T13 folds the rare-skill mistakes into '11 mistakes on rare skills are parked until after Nov 7 · Show' (today.md:853). v2's test-day checklist is a `<details>` that stays closed until the eve (rebuild-v2.md:2906), so from 7 days out to 2 days out, the days when a student can still fix a missing ID or ticket, it is collapsed. Both conflict with decision 4 ('never… collapsed away'). The rehearsal also promises 'start around 8:30, like the real day' (today.md:841), while the Math section actually starts after R&W and the break. The file's own open question admits this, but the copy states it as fact.
failures.fix: Show the parked mistakes as a visible second group, `RARE SKILLS · after Nov 7 · 11`, with their rows and their own `Fix · 22`. Render the checklist open from 7 days out, with its count in the heading. Change the rehearsal copy to 'at the time your Math section will start (after R&W and the break)', and default the time to R&W start + 2h15m once the time is verified. Until then say 'pick your time' and give no claim.

failures.feature: Hero and the day's receipt (their All Done badge): T19
failures.why_not_way_better: From the second visit of the day, the receipt shrinks to 'one line at the top of Up next with its Show' (today.md:1146). That collapses the page's outcome summary to look lighter, which decision 4 forbids. It also adds a second points-moved number, '≈ +8 claimed' (U4's table total at midnight minus now, today.md:1143), next to T10's 'Practice since Sep 21: ≈ +15' (ΔS). The two use different formulas and can differ in size or even sign on the same page, because gains are capped at 80% and the table total can rise after a bad session. The file's own 'one source per fact' rule is broken again.
failures.fix: Keep the full receipt expanded all day. Only the `.rise` entry animation plays once. Define 'claimed' as `estimate.practice_delta` over today (ΔS from local midnight to now), the same function as T10. When it is negative, print it as '≈ −5 today' rather than hiding it.

failures.feature: Skip / Move a task and recent tests: stale v2 endpoints left in place
failures.why_not_way_better: The override list says it covers 'every place that changes' (today.md:6), but it leaves in endpoints that R-resolutions say will not be built, and the acceptance checks still test them. §3b says Skip and Move 'send POST /api/plan/mark' (rebuild-v2.md:2559). §3.2.5 specifies the plan_marks table and POST /api/plan/mark (3209–3217), and acceptance 14 (3318) tests it, while R14 (rebuild-v2.md:150) says 'plan_marks… and POST /api/plan/mark are not built'. §3.2.5 also still specifies 'GET /api/tests/recent (new)' (3179), and acceptance 8–10 (3312–3314) call it, while R26 (162) says it is not built. PUT /api/me still stamps `plan_started` (3206), while R15 says that is `plans.start`. A builder who runs the section's acceptance list cannot pass it.
failures.fix: Add overrides to §3.1. Replace every `POST /api/plan/mark` / plan_marks mention in §3b, §3.2.5 and acceptance 14 with S7's `PATCH /api/plan/{id}/tasks/{task} {status:'skipped'|'moved', to_day}`. Rewrite acceptance 8–10 against `/api/history?kind=tests&all=1` (modules[].wrong/blank, gated). Delete the `plan_started` stamping and point Day N of M at `plans.start`.
